name: Jordon Riley
head: https://a.espncdn.com/i/headshots/nfl/players/full/4240677.png
college: Oregon; Nebraska; Garden City CC; North Carolina

inj.note: Riley has been on the active/PUP list since Aug. 31 while continuing to recover from a torn Achilles tendon. The defensive lineman made his return to practice Wednesday, logging a limited session to open the week. With Javon Hargrave (Achilles) done for the season, Riley's return to action will be a welcomed one, whenever that may be.
